title: Arrow IPC / Flight codec instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Arrow IPC / Flight codec instance's settings: the IPC variant, the schema source, and the Flight endpoint with its ticket and TLS. A format is a codec used by other connectors, not a source, so this config holds no credentials and no secrets (§33 Appendix A.6; CN1 plan Task 5; design §33 §8 row 10). The manifest's `secrets` list is empty because no property here carries a secret.

ipc_format.description: The Arrow IPC variant (CN1 Task 5: stream and file).

schema_source.description: Where the Arrow schema comes from; an IPC stream carries it inline, so this only matters when a schema must be pinned.

schema.description: The pinned Arrow schema as its JSON form, when schema_source is `explicit`.

schema_url.description: A URL the Arrow schema is fetched from, when schema_source is `url`.

batch_rows.description: Rows per emitted record batch (CN1 Ruling 3's default).

flight.description: Flight settings for DoGet and DoPut, including Loams's own Flight SQL endpoint for collections and streams (CN1 Task 5's flight_doget_from_loams).

endpoint.description: The Flight endpoint, as grpc+tls://host:port or grpc://host:port.

ticket.description: The DoGet ticket, for a source. A ticket that names a path or SQL statement is the usual form.

database.description: The Flight SQL database to qualify the ticket with.

auth.description: How the Flight call authenticates; the manifest's auth slugs none, mtls and jwt (§33 Appendix A.6).

tls.description: TLS material for a grpc+tls:// endpoint.

verify_full.description: Whether the server certificate's hostname is verified.

dictionary_batch_rows.description: Rows per dictionary batch; 0 disables dictionary encoding.
